svg.title: fig03
svg.desc: Figure 3 | How the five changes reduce execution time. (a,b) Conceptual fragments illustrate unchanged topology reuse and reduced copying/repeated operations; their geometry is illustrative. (c) Complete- process wall time at cumulative stages S0–S5 for 500 and 1,000 robots. Stage values are geometric means of seed medians from three timing repetitions per stage and ten complete seeds; the vertical axis is logarithmic. Blue squares and solid lines denote 500 robots; purple circles and dashed lines denote 1,000 robots. S0 is reference; S1–S5 add the five changes in Figure 2 order. (d) Paired cumulative S0/S5 wall and CPU speedups with registered deterministic 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals. Blue squares denote wall time; purple open circles denote CPU time. Wall speedups are 8.4454× (8.2915–8.6021) and 14.7229× (14.3003–15.1753). (e) Geometric-mean peak RSS across cumulative stages, approximately 44 and 55 MiB. This historical-order experiment measures cumulative contributions, not independent factorial effects.
